paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Matya, Yevamot 10:3, 92a. Rav Yehudah in Rav’s name: “He should have expounded a pearl, but expounded a potsherd,” there 94, end of a. One of Yavneh’s four sages, with ben Azzai, ben Zoma, and Chananya ben Chakhinai (see there). Kiddushin 32a, baraita on honoring parents; Pesachim 79, end of b; Tosefta, Pesachim, chapter 6, disputes with Yehudah. Tosefta Sotah, chapter 2: Yehudah ben Beteira in Elazar ben Matya’s name; Yehudah in his name. In Sotah 34a and Tosefta, chapter 8, Rabbi Yehudah reports that Elazar ben Matya, Abba Chalafta, and Chananya ben Chakhinai stood by Joshua’s stones and estimated their weight. Jerusalem Talmud, end of Ma'aser Sheni, chapter 2: “Those who deliberate before the sages”—ben Azzai and ben Zoma; “the students”—Elazar ben Matya and Chananya ben Chakhinai. Yuchasin’s chronological section: apparently son of Matya ben Charash.
